pkgmetadata.longdescription: PuLP is a linear programming (LP) modeler written in Python. It generates MPS or LP files and can call external solvers including GLPK (via sci-mathematics/glpk), CBC (via sci-libs/coinor-cbc), CPLEX, HiGHS, and GUROBI. Bundled CBC solver binaries are not installed; use system packages instead.
